task.pr_title: Don't need label column for inference TextClassification.

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
>labelCol [](http://example.com/codeflow?start=130&length=8)

is it possible this can be null? The call GetColumnOrNull suggests it can return null.

evidence.thread_resolution:
michaelgsharp: Yes, and I thought I was checking before that call but it doesn't look like I am. Good catch, let me add that.
michaelgsharp: Ok, I have added a check in for all the input schema, so that line will never return null since an error will be thrown prior if there is a problem.
